summary: Loads tire brand (.tbc) entries into an array owned by 'this'. Releases prior texture surfaces, saves the FPU control word (default 512), builds the season directory path from dword_5EC3D8 + dword_5EC428 (each falling back to byte_5EA438), searches that directory for '.tbc' files, allocates a 36-byte-per-entry array prefixed by the entry count, initializes each entry with sentinels, parses every file via TireBrandFileParser, logs a 'No tire brands .tbc' warning when empty, and restores the FPU control word (via EmptyStub_7780 when it differs from 512). Called by GameFileLoader.

local_names.v7/v8: allocated entry array pointer (36 bytes per entry, count stored at prefix)
local_names.v12: byte index into the entry array
local_names.v15: pointer to the entry slot parsed for this file

operations.description: TextureSurfaceDestroyer(this) releases previously loaded texture surfaces.
v2 = FPUControlWordMaskExtract(512) saves the FPU control word; v4/v17 retain it for later restoration.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v18, "%s%s" (aSS), dword_5EC3D8|byte_5EA438, dword_5EC428|byte_5EA438) builds the season directory path.
sub_565F80(aTbc, 1, v18, 1) enumerates files with the '.tbc' extension in the season directory.
v6 = ShortComputation_5f70(&unk_8AD3B0) counts the matching entries; *this = v6 stores the count.
v7 = OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(36 * v6 + 4) allocates the entry array; on success store count at *v7 and point v8 at the entries.
Initialize each 36-byte entry (stride of 9 dwords) with StructInitWithSentinels.
this[1] = v8 stores the allocated entry array pointer (null when allocation failed).
If (count == 0 or entry array null) and StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_4, 1025), call DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aNoTireBrandsTb) to log the missing-brands warning.
LinkedListPopFront_5f50(&unk_8AD3B0) removes the front search-list node.

Iterate directory entries via DirectoryEntryIterator(&unk_8AD3B0); for each entry build the full "%s%s%s" (aSSS_0) path from dir, season and name via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, then TireBrandFileParser(entry, v18) parses it.
Break the per-file loop when LinkedListNodePeek(&unk_8AD3B0) returns null (no further nodes).
result = sub_565EB0(&unk_8AD3B0); if the saved FPU word v4 != 512, restore it via EmptyStub_7780(v4); otherwise return result.
